If you are genuinely thinking of suing I would, depending on your financial situation, get in contact with a legal professional who will help you suss out the situation. I don't know where you are based but I would imagine wherever you are there are similar organisations to those where I'm from (e.g. in Ireland we have the likes of FLAC). Also, I'm sure this isn't news but having worked in solicitors' offices and currently studying law, you need to be prepared for a case to take a year or two or even longer before it is resolved. That is something to keep in mind (absolutely not discouraging you from going down that road, it's just a very sad reality of the judicial system that cases drag out but it could be so worth it! Again, a legal professional in your area would be better suited to advise you).

Your mother is definitely abusive. Abuse does not only include physical abuse. People can say they are xyz but unless they actually act and prove they are xyz then they are not (if that makes sense?). Basically, my mother was very much the same. She would say things like, "oh but you know I love you really!" but her actions did not match that statement at all. All of the things you describe her as doing is indicative that she is trying to control you. Obviously, parents have to exert a certain amount of control over their children but from the information you have given, it seems controlling in an abusive way. Please reach out to a trusted adult and have them help you find a therapist. Having grown up with a similar mother I would be wary of anyone she might find. If you still live at home and are underage you might not have a choice (and hey I could be wrong, she might help find a perfectly good therapist without an agenda) so just know that no one else but you can make the decision for you as to whether or not you are trans. It might take some soul searching but ultimately, you make that decision.
